subject: Expansion playbook & evaluation timeline: Nova Solutions renewal MAP kickoff
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@novasolutions.com>, Rajiv Sharma <rajiv@novasolutions.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion playbook & evaluation timeline: Nova Solutions renewal MAP kickoff

Hi Emily (and team),

Thanks again for the productive check-in last week — excited to kick off the formal MAP for Nova's upcoming renewal. I’ve attached a first-pass mutual action plan (Nova_MAP_v1.0.docx) and a lightweight usage snapshot (usage_report_Mar2026.csv) to ground the discussion.

Goals for this MAP:
- Align stakeholders and roles for the renewal & evaluation cycle
- Agree on a timeline for technical evaluation, procurement, and commercial close
- Surface short-term upsell opportunities tied to usage patterns

Proposed high-level timeline (suggested):
1) 2026-03-29: Confirm internal/external stakeholders + ownership (today/tomorrow)
2) 2026-04-01: MAP kickoff call — review goals, success criteria, and telemetry needs
3) 2026-04-07: Technical eval complete (POC sign-off or list of outstanding blockers)
4) 2026-04-14: Commercial proposal & pricing review
5) 2026-04-21: Target close for renewal + any expansion commitments

Suggested internal owners (happy to adjust):
- Marcus Lin (Account Exec) — overall MAP owner / commercial lead
- Lauren Bishop (CSM) — usage review, onboarding and upsell coordination
- Monica Patel (Solutions Architect) — eval support, technical deep dives
- David Kim (Customer Success Director) — executive escalation / contract approvals

Could you confirm who from Nova should be invited (product, procurement, security) and whether the proposed 4/1 kickoff at 10:00 AM PT works? If that time doesn’t work, suggest two other slots next week.

Attachments: Nova_MAP_v1.0.docx, usage_report_Mar2026.csv

Thanks — looking forward to partnering on a clean, predictable renewal and some sensible expansion work where it fits.

—
Marcus Lin
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0172

From: Emily Park <emily.park@novasolutions.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Sharma <rajiv@novasolutions.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion playbook & evaluation timeline: Nova Solutions renewal MAP kickoff

Hi Marcus — thanks, this looks great.

Confirmed stakeholders on our side:
- Emily Park (me) — Head of Integrations / MAP exec sponsor
- Rajiv Sharma — Procurement (contract + timelines)
- Sara Li — VP Product (technical acceptance and success criteria)

4/1 at 10:00 AM PT works for me and for Rajiv. I’ll loop Sara once I confirm with her calendar — she’s in APAC but can join early if needed.

Couple of asks before the kickoff: can you include a short section in the MAP that calls out what success looks like for our product team (latency/throughput SLAs, KV cache behavior, and quantization tradeoffs)? Also please include the commercial tiers you’d propose so procurement has a feel for options.

Thanks — Emily
Emily Park
Head of Integrations, Nova Solutions
emily.park@novasolutions.com

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Emily Park <emily.park@novasolutions.com>, Sara Li <sara.li@novasolutions.com>, Rajiv Sharma <rajiv@novasolutions.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, David Kim <david_kim@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 28 Mar 2026 10:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Expansion playbook & evaluation timeline: Nova Solutions renewal MAP kickoff

Emily — perfect, appreciate the quick confirmation. I’ve updated the MAP to include a short success criteria section aimed at product (latency < 100ms p95 on typical payload, end-to-end throughput targets, and a note on KV-cache behavior). I also attached our standard pricing tiers to give procurement a starting point (redwood_pricing_tiers.pdf).

Meeting: 2026-04-01 10:00 AM PT — I'll send a calendar invite in a separate email with dial-in details. Agenda (30–40 minutes):
- Introductions & MAP roles (5 min)
- Review success criteria & evaluation acceptance (10 min)
- Usage findings & immediate optimization opportunities (10 min)
- Commercial options & next steps (5–10 min)

Immediate action items (owners & due dates):
- Nova: confirm Sara’s availability for the 4/1 slot (Emily) — due 2026-03-29
- Redwood: add product success criteria to MAP and circulate (Marcus) — done (attached)
- Redwood: prep a short upsell options deck tied to top usage patterns (Lauren) — deliver by 2026-03-30
- Nova: share any security/compliance constraints up front (Emily/Rajiv) — due 2026-03-31

Attachments: redwood_pricing_tiers.pdf (pricing), updated MAP (Nova_MAP_v1.0.docx)

On the call we can also decide whether you want a short technical proof-of-concept window (1 week) for the largest integration path — Monica will own that work from our side.

—
Marcus

Subject: RE: Expansion playbook & evaluation timeline: Nova Solutions renewal MAP kickoff — upsell & usage plan

Hi all — adding a bit more color from CS on the upsell and evaluation side.

Short upsell playbook (3 prioritized routes):
1) Convert burst usage into a Dedicated Baseline (guaranteed throughput + lower unit cost)
2) Move embedding-heavy features to Redwood embeddings tier (volume discounts)
3) Terms-based credits for predictable spend + a usage-optimization engagement (workshop)

To tailor these proposals I’d like to run a one-off usage export to identify the top 5 calling apps, peak windows, and token distribution. Edward on my team will run the export — can Nova confirm that’s ok? I’ll also prepare a 1-page upsell_options outline to share on 3/30.

Related links: HubSpot deal (https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/deal/DEAL-2026-137), shared MAP folder (https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cMAPs)

Attachments: upsell_playbook_outline.pdf

If security needs a heads-up we can redact user identifiers and only share aggregated data.

—
Lauren Bishop
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
lauren_bishop@redwood.com | +1 (617) 555-0124

See you on 4/1.

Best,
Emily
